topbarSubtitle: tide.com rebuilt on AEM Edge Delivery Services

slides.leadParagraph: Real tide.com pages and content: home, shop, our commitment, how to wash clothes, what's new, rewards.
bulletPoints: Product browse, stain finder, carousels and cards
Compare side by side with tide.com

slides.leadParagraph: Every page is a document in Document Authoring: headings, text, images and blocks in tables.
bulletPoints: Edit the home page in DA
Edit nav and footer once, everywhere

slides.leadParagraph: The Library panel lists cards, columns, carousel, product grid, stain finder, tabs and more, each with a Tide example.
bulletPoints: Open a page in DA, then Library, then Blocks
Insert a Carousel or Product Grid
Header and footer variants are set in site metadata

slides.leadParagraph: Lighthouse scores of 100 for performance, accessibility and best practices on mobile and desktop are the target for every page.
Site search runs on the query index. The contact form posts to the shared demo endpoint.
bulletPoints: Do not submit the form live: it posts to a shared channel

slides.leadParagraph: Request Publish routes changes to an approver, Schedule Publish queues a go-live, and Multi-Site Manager rolls content out to other locales.
bulletPoints: Request Publish: Library, then Request Publish
Schedule Publish and Multi-Site Manager: the Prepare menu in DA

slides.leadParagraph: None are set by default. Add Experiment metadata to a page and a challenger page to run an A/B test.
bulletPoints: Experiment: <id> and Experiment Variants: <path> in page metadata
